thread:
Maya Patel: incident-bot flagged increased 5xxs and p95 in helixcare-vpc canary slice (tenant=helixcare-canary). Watch started 10:12 UTC. @Theo Grant please take the page.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: helixcare-vpc canary error-rate >4% and p95 > 2s over 5m. Alert ID: INC-20260315-0087

Theo Grant: On call. Quick context?

Maya Patel: Canary rollout of artifact gnx-31 began ~10:05 UTC. Since ~10:10 UTC we see a rising stream of 502s hitting /v1/chat and p95 climbing 200ms -> 2.6s. Errors concentrated on canary slice for HelixCare tenant. Logs show redis timeouts and one worker OOM (worker-5).

Lina Park: I notified the customer account lead. HelixCare SRE (A. Moreno) is watching their side and reports failing health checks briefly.

Omar Reyes: Observability: KV cache miss ratio jumped and connection queue length to redis exceeded threshold. Worker-5 restarted twice at 10:11:22 and 10:12:09. Artifact gnx-31 introduced a new tiled attention kernel and a config change to prefetching.

Priya Singh: Support: customer is asking if we can route them off canary ASAP. They see request failures affecting API gateways.

Viktor Chen: Hypothesis: the tiled attention increases peak RSS for long-context requests. On our constrained canary worker the increased working set caused swap and then redis connection backlog. If true, pinning tenant to prior artifact r-20260220-stable should restore stability.

Samira Ali: Customer update queued: we'll tell them we're temporarily moving their traffic to the last known-good artifact and investigating. They want a 30-minly update cadence.

Theo Grant: Agreed plan: (1) freeze canary promotions, (2) pin HelixCare tenant to r-20260220-stable, (3) gather traces and GC/heap dumps for gnx-31. Jamal, can you perform the pin and capture audit id?

Jamal Ortiz: On it. cURL to pin via control plane:

```
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/tenants/helixcare/pin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"artifact":"r-20260220-stable","reason":"emergency pinback due to elevated 5xx in canary"}'
```

deploy-bot: Deploy lock engaged for pool helixcare-vpc-canary (lock-id: dl-9023). Further promotions blocked.

Jamal Ortiz: API responded 202. Console shows tenant helixcare pinned -> r-20260220-stable. Saved request id req-8801 and screenshot.

Omar Reyes: Immediate effect: pinned slice error-rate dropped from 4.5% -> 0.6% within 70s. p95 back to ~310ms for pinned traffic. Other canary slices still showing noise from gnx-31.

Maya Patel: Theo, propose we declare this customer-impact incident and assign roles. I can be scribe.

Theo Grant: Declaring Sev-2 (customer-impact). Incident Commander: Theo Grant. Scribe: Maya Patel. Objectives: contain customer impact, validate pinned artifact performance, collect diagnostics for gnx-31, prepare rollback if pin fails.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-0087 assigned to Theo Grant as Incident Commander.

Samira Ali: Customer notified at 10:22 UTC: short note + mitigation + ETA for next update (10:52 UTC).

Viktor Chen: Diagnostics plan: collect heap/GC traces from affected worker images, compare kernel memory footprints between gnx-31 and r-20260220-stable, reproduce on reserved worker with long-seq prompts.

Priya Singh: Support: logged ticket ST-20260315-215 for SLA review. Customer may request credits depending on duration.

Theo Grant: Rolling decisions: if pin holds for 15m and metrics stable, keep tenant pinned while we triage. If errors reappear or we see expansion beyond this tenant, execute full canary rollback of gnx-31 across the pool.

Maya Patel: Omar, can you prepare a rollback manifest and checklist? Include steps to drain canary, apply r-20260220-stable to canary pool, validate health, unfreeze promotions only when safe.

Omar Reyes: Will prepare. Rollback checklist highlights:
1) Announce rollback in channel
2) Acquire deploy lock (deploy-bot will grant)
3) Drain canary slice and stop scheduling gnx-31 on canary nodes
4) Apply r-20260220-stable to the pool
5) Monitor 5m windows for errors/latency
6) If stable, promote or keep pinned pending patch

Jamal Ortiz: Confirmed deploy lock dl-9023 in place until IC releases.

Lina Park: Customer liaison: HelixCare asked for a timeline to patch. We'll tell them we'll run diagnostics and aim for a technical update within 2 hours.

Viktor Chen: Preliminary root cause note: gnx-31's tiled attention increases working set for some query shapes and interacts badly with our connection pooling under memory pressure, leading to backlog and 502s. I'll upload flamegraphs and kernel diffs to the incident doc.

Samira Ali: Legal/compliance reminder: this is a dedicated VPC customer; keep a full audit trail of pin actions, notifications, and who executed commands.

Maya Patel: Jamal, attach request id and console snapshot to the incident record. Omar, attach the deploy-bot lock info.

Jamal Ortiz: Done. req-8801 and screenshot saved in incident attachments. deploy-bot lock dl-9023 logged.

Theo Grant: For on-call handoff: I'll stay for the next 45m. If I hand off, assign to Viktor. Keep the tenant pinned. Next status update will be posted at 10:52 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deploy lock dl-9023 active. Use /deploy unlock dl-9023 to release when IC approves.

Priya Singh: 10:33 UTC 0% customer update sent. Noted that customer appreciates speed of mitigation.

Omar Reyes: 10:40 UTC  diagnostics snapshot: worker-5 heap dump shows elevated RSS ~1.8x over baseline with gnx-31 under 3k token prompts; redis backlog metrics correlated with eviction spikes.

Viktor Chen: 10:48 UTC  will run regression on reserved worker with r-20260220-stable and gnx-31, ramp to 10rps and long-seq prompts. Will report differences in resident set, GC frequency, and connection queue lengths.

Theo Grant: Holding for now. If any regen, ping @here. If pinned slice regresses, we move to full rollback immediately. Scribe Maya, keep the incident doc updated with artifacts and owner assignments.

Maya Patel: Logged actions & owners: Viktor (RCA + artifacts), Omar (rollback manifest + infra checks), Jamal (audit + routing snapshots), Priya (customer comms). Incident reminder: keep messages short in thread and include timestamps for each update.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-0087 status: mitigation in place (tenant pinned). Next update due 10:52 UTC.

Theo Grant: Thanks team. Monitoring continues. If anything changes, escalate in-channel and call the incident bridge.

Priya Singh: Customer says "thank you" and will await updates. Ticket ST-20260315-215 open.

Maya Patel: Converting to ongoing incident coordination. We'll produce a post-incident review after triage.
